description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'RequestPasswordController' class, which manages password reset requests within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It integrates with the application's components, services, and traits to handle CSRF tokens and email service configuration before rendering the password reset page.

classes.name: RequestPasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password reset request page display, integrating email configuration status and CSRF token management.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmailService used to check email configuration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering, choosing between password reset form or warning based on email config; sets template and component for the view.
